text.p: DiaSys Corp said on Friday that it disputes remarks made by Intelligent Medical Imaging Inc, which the day before had announced it was ending its product integration pact with the company.
DiaSys described the remarks as materially incorrect and misleading statements concerning the relationship between the two companies.
Intelligent Medical had said in a statement that "the agreement was terminated for cause due to breaches of the agreement by DiaSys, including the failure to deliver conforming goods."

But DiaSys President and Chief Executive Todd DeMatteo said in a statement that "the company has hundreds of workstations in operation both here and abroad, including major commercial laboratory chains and nationally known medical centers."
DeMatteo added that IMI's statements are misleading as IMI did not provide DiaSys the opportunity to help IMI in an attempt to integrate DiaSys' workstations.
